Use case: stylized-concept. Create a PRODUCTION transparent PNG sprite asset for a cozy desktop widget. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match the clean friendly 2D CARTOON illustrations of the potted plants, especially their smooth dark green contour outlines, rounded simplified organic shapes, flat muted color fills, and only two or three broad cel-shaded color regions. Use the same visual family as those plants. This asset must unmistakably look like a hand-drawn CARTOON, not a realistic miniature, watercolor, oil painting, photograph, intricate texture, 3D render, or flat geometric placeholder. No tiny noisy detail. No faces or anthropomorphism.
Output ONE wide 2:1 RGBA PNG with TWO EQUAL square cells arranged horizontally: left is daylight, right is night version of the SAME subject with matching composition, scale, silhouette and baseline. Transparent alpha background in both cells, no background color, no checkerboard, no enclosing square/round badge, no UI, no text, no letters, no frame, no watermark. Keep the whole object inside its cell with 12% transparent margin all around, and a clean transparent gap at the middle. Each subject should occupy about 76% of cell width and height. Use smooth crisp edges and confident consistent contour strokes, very gentle simple shadows contained within object shape. Day colors: sage green, mint, warm cream, muted blue and terracotta. Night: desaturated blue/teal with lighter contour edges as necessary, still colorful and clearly readable on dark graphite. These sprites will be shown about 60px wide, so shapes must be substantial and legible.
